title: shedding
body:
legs crossed
back embraced by something
cotton
or polyester
I don't really know.

hands running
fingers through fur
gold
and snow,
tufts of fur I know well.

each strand weaving itself into my clothing.

every time I leave the gold of Los Angeles
to face the snow of Boston,
a part of you comes with me.

and as my clothes shed
those little keratin pieces of you
Im reminded of how long its been since we've
sat on that couch, paws on jeans, listening to the hands
click by on the clock

and as those strands of fur become
a distant memory as new ones grow in
I hope you don't forget me like you've forgotten them
